resources.string: Lightson needs WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS to control the colour filter. Connect your phone to a computer with adb and run:
adb shell pm grant app.lightson android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Show the whole screen in black and white
Apps that always open in full colour
Service enabled — tap to open accessibility settings
Service disabled — tap to enable it in accessibility settings
Detects which app is in the foreground so the grayscale filter can be switched off for your chosen colour apps and restored afterwards. Lightson does not read any screen content.
